newsitem.title: USA: Phillips,allies plan $110 mln to start Hamaca.
newsitem.headline: Phillips,allies plan $110 mln to start Hamaca.

text.p: Phillips Petroleum Co and its partners ARCO, Petroleos de Venezuela's Corpoven unit and Texaco Inc will invest $110 million in the Hamaca extra-heavy oil project in Venezuela in the first 18 months of the project.
After the first phase is complete, Phillips and its partners will decide on whether to proceed with the full development of the $3.5 billion project.
On Wednesday, the Venezuelan Congress approved the joint venture programme, which Corpoven estimates has 2.4 billion barrels of heavy oil reserves.

Phillips said that if the project is fully developed, daily production could be 200,000 barrels of oil by 2006, with initial production starting in 1999. ((-- David Chance New York Newsroom 212 859 1902))
